title: Esau Sells His Birthright
description: Esau comes home exhausted from the field and sells his birthright to his twin brother Jacob for bread and lentil stew.

versions.title: Esau Sells His Birthright
versions.description: Esau sells his birthright to Jacob for a bowl of lentil stew.
versions.reason: [minor] references: Verses 19-26 deal with Isaac's lineage, Rebekah's pregnancy, and the birth of the twins, while the actual sale of the birthright occurs in verses 27-34. The range is somewhat broad, but verses 19-26 provide necessary background for the story.
